author: BigHero6
body:
Minecraft Username: O4T

Discord ID: O4T#4361

In 1 or 2 sentences, tell me who you are: My name is Taelon and I am 11 years old. I play on your server and am planning to record on it sometime. I like to play sports (Basketball and sometimes soccer.) And upload YouTube content. I don't necessarily record/upload often but I do it when I have enough time to. 

What is your Youtube channel? https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCObtkAycR45IbAhIbroR0OQ

What software do you use when recording videos? Do you have experience editing videos? I use oCam to record. I have experience editing videos, but it's not a pro editing software nor is it a pro way of doing it.

Have you ever advertised using YouTube? No.

Have you ever marketed something using YouTube before? No.

What changes would you like to see made on the YouTube team? It seems fine so far.

How active are you/how is your work ethic? I have been on for about 3 hours a day. In my opinion my videos are okay for the moment.

title: Social Media App - YT

replies.author: K_R_Cord
replies.body:
Hello BigHero6,

We regret to inform you that we will be denying you from the team. I do however want to give you some tips on improving yourself for YouTube and for a better chance if you want to apply again.
-Get to know Avicus a little more and get more input from some of our experts from your videos.
-Learn how to edit your videos and play around with it. 
-Learn to utilize your audio better with your current operating system.

I believe if you are able to get better at those 3 three things it will really help you in the future. 

Thank you for applying,
Kord and the Social Media Team.
